properties.notes: Rioters in Mango protest a project for the protection of wildlife because they want the land to be used for agriculture. Rioters lit tyres, threw stones at police and stole weapons. 5 killed, 13 injured, 50 arrested.

properties.actor1: Rioters (Togo)
properties.notes: Rioters (many students) ransacked the prefecture in Dapaong to protest against the militia violence against teachers and health workers that occurred on Mar. 15.

properties.actor1: Unidentified Armed Group (Togo)
properties.notes: A militia armed with machetes and clubs attacked teachers and health workers at a meeting of the Synergy Workers of Togo/Coalition of Togolese Workers in Dapaong, 600km north of Lome. Several injuries reported.

properties.actor1: Moba Communal Militia (Togo)
properties.notes: Villagers of Borgou discovered the body of a farmer in a field, killed by pastoralists. This sparked clashes between the villagers and pastoralists on the 22nd and 23rd December, resulting in six deaths.
